resources.string: Monitoring on screen off · Idle while screen is on
Tap the switch to activate screen-off tap detection

Android powers off capacitive touch when the screen is off. This app listens to your hardware motion sensor only while the display is off, detects two crisp physical taps, and briefly wakes the screen via PowerManager before immediately releasing the WakeLock.
No hardware accelerometer was detected on this device. Sensor-based tap detection is unavailable.
Note: Without a hardware wake-up accelerometer, Android Deep Doze may pause sensors after prolonged idle.
Shows when screen-off double tap monitoring is active.
Idle while screen is on · Ready when screen turns off
Android restricted automatic start after reboot. Tap here to resume.
Android 13+ requires notification permission to display the background service status.
Firmly double-tap the screen glass or back of your phone right now to verify your sensitivity setting.
Start the 5-second timer, then immediately press your Power button to turn off the screen. The app will trigger an official PowerManager wake and release the WakeLock.
Screen was already ON when timer finished. Lock the screen during the countdown to test screen-off wake.
Automatically restart monitoring after phone reboot when the feature is enabled.

Sensors are completely unregistered while your screen is ON to preserve battery. However, Android Doze and manufacturer battery savers may suspend background sensor listening while idle. Setting this app to Unrestricted improves reliability.
No Internet · No Analytics · No Ads · No Root · No AccessibilityService
Wakes the display briefly via PowerManager and releases immediately.
Keeps screen-off sensor listening running reliably after you close the app.
Restores the service automatically after a device restart.
Displays the required transparent foreground status notification.
Why no AccessibilityService? Android disables the capacitive touch digitizer when the screen is off, so AccessibilityService cannot receive screen-off touches anyway and is not needed.

Samsung One UI includes hardware-level \"Double tap to turn on screen\" in Settings → Advanced features → Motions and gestures. If using this app instead, exclude it from Sleeping Apps in Battery settings.
Google Pixel supports hardware-level \"Tap to check phone\" in Settings → Display → Lock screen. This app provides an accelerometer-based alternative.
Xiaomi / MIUI / HyperOS includes native \"Double tap to wake\" in Settings → Always-on display & Lock screen. For background reliability, enable Autostart and set Battery saver to No restrictions.

OnePlus / OPPO / Realme devices include native \"Double tap to wake\" under Settings → Special features / Gestures & motions → Screen-off gestures. Disable battery optimization for reliable background wake.
Motorola devices offer native \"Tap to wake\" in Settings → Display → Peek Display / Lock screen. Exclude this app from battery optimization for best idle response.
Huawei / Honor devices support native wake gestures under Settings → Accessibility features → Shortcuts & gestures. Set App Launch to Manual for background reliability.
Sony Xperia devices support Tap to wake in Settings → Display → Lock screen. Standard accelerometer listening pauses in Deep Doze unless a wake-up sensor is present.
Standard Android disables capacitive touch when the screen is off. Check Settings → Display → Lock screen for native hardware Tap-to-Wake, or use this app\'s accelerometer tap detector.
